description: List an item's investigation records. The structured, read-only investigation records on a queue item — the findings / blocking questions / QA notes an AI agent posted while working it, plus its `working` run rows. Returns `published` records only, newest first (max 50).

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: ops_investigations_list
